name: E2E-SEEDV-001 — F0商品标签变更同时触发图片+视频双生产
description: 验证F0层级变更事件同时启动图片种草(现有)和视频种草(新增)两条独立生产：TIER_TAG_CHANGED消息 → F层级=F0 → 图片seedGenerate(不变) + 视频seedVideoGenerate(新增) → 两条PENDING记录分别落库 → 分别按容量/去重提交
module: 上游素材生产链路/种草视频链路

steps.expression: (() => { return { testType: 'upstream-rule-validation', trigger: 'F88_AI_ITEM_TIER_TAG_CHANGED', messageBody: { taoItemId: '${seedVideoItemId}', shopUserId: '${seedVideoSellerId}' }, expected: { imagePipeline: { processMode: 'seedGenerate', pipelineId: 'MaterialRouteDiamondConfig.pipelineSeed()' }, videoPipeline: { processMode: 'seedVideoGenerate', pipelineId: '20227', totalSwitchDefault: 'OFF' } } }; })()

(() => { const spec = ${dualTriggerSpec}; return { case: 'F0同时触发图片+视频', itemId: spec.messageBody.taoItemId, sellerId: spec.messageBody.shopUserId, checks: { imageTriggered: true, videoTriggered: true, imagePipelineId: spec.expected.imagePipeline.pipelineId, videoPipelineId: spec.expected.videoPipeline.pipelineId, independent: '图片/视频两条链路独立提交,互不影响' } }; })()

验证视频生产链路被触发

steps.expression: (() => { return { validation: 'F0双触发规则', checks: [ { name: '消息TAG', expected: 'F88_AI_ITEM_TIER_TAG_CHANGED', pass: true }, { name: '图片链路触发', expected: 'seedGenerate → pipelineSeed', pass: true }, { name: '视频链路触发', expected: 'seedVideoGenerate → 20227', pass: true }, { name: '两条链路独立', expected: '各自独立提交,互不影响', pass: true }, { name: '视频总开关默认关', expected: '上线先关,验证后打开', pass: true } ] }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发环境MQ可用；视频总开关已打开验证；存在未触发过视频种草的F0测试商品(sellerId=2219662018344)
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.打开视频总开关 2.构造F88_AI_ITEM_TIER_TAG_CHANGED消息 3.消费端查询F层级=F0 4.同时触发triggerSeedGenerate(图片)+triggerSeedVideoGenerate(视频) 5.两条PENDING记录落库 6.分别按容量提交
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①图片与视频两条PENDING记录同时落库 ②视频记录processMode=seedVideoGenerate, pipelineId=20227 ③两条链路分别按各自的容量/去重窗口提交
_testDesign.dbAssertion: ai_process_record: 同一item_id存在两条记录, sceneType='GENERATE', bizType='MATERIAL', processMode IN ('seedGenerate','seedVideoGenerate')
_testDesign.apiAssertion: 两条链路独立调用afdMaterialProdHsfService,视频侧使用pipelineId=20227
riskPoints: 视频总开关未打开时视频链路不触发,仅图片链路正常
两条链路共享同一F层级查询结果,需避免重复调用浪费资源
